purpose: The labelled control corpus for the V8 structured-extraction scans and generation binds (the R42 verdict D1/D2/D5 acceptance). Every label carries its byte-verified provenance; the corpus mixes REAL committed rows (burned holdout bytes) with LABELLED FIXTURES (mechanics-proving per Art. 22; each fixture is typed FIXTURE and never counts as a fresh-problem capability measurement).
precision_recall_convention: The precision/recall acceptance (F57: >= 0.9 both) is computed per scan class over the LABELLED entries only; entries typed ADJUDICATION-PENDING are excluded from the denominator (the in-band R42 verdict says the 7 ALLOWED_ROW_OUTSIDE are 'mostly' wordform/apparatus false positives — the per-finding adjudication lives in the auditor's PRIVATE score record, not read; the 4 unambiguous parsing artifacts are labelled NEGATIVE by construction, the 3 apparatus/wordform ones stay PENDING).

- Standard practice delivers a monitoring scheme using approach temperature.
- Departure: a COP-degradation index computed from existing signals.

Governing relation: COP = Q_cooling / P_compressor with Q_cooling from the measured temperatures and flow.

IMPLEMENTATION BILL
INPUT INVENTORY:
- condenser-water inlet temperature — source: ALREADY-RECORDED (the problem's existing condenser-water inlet temperature sensor)
- condenser-water outlet temperature — source: ALREADY-RECORDED (the existing outlet sensor)
- condenser-water flow rate — source: ALREADY-RECORDED (the existing flow meter)
- compressor input power — source: ALREADY-RECORDED (the existing power meter)
- COP degradation index — source: DERIVED (from the four permitted signals above; stated physics)

BURDEN LEDGER (STANDARD-PRACTICE PARITY)
- Installability: same (software on the existing historian).

EXECUTABLE TEST
Protocol: 30-day validation against the historian.
